name: Wyoming Wildlife and Natural Resource Trust habitat grants

funder.name: Wyoming Wildlife and Natural Resource Trust

summary: Grants from a Wyoming state trust for improving terrestrial and aquatic wildlife habitat, watershed enhancement and open-space conservation easements, open to nonprofits and governmental organisations. Applications are due twice a year.
reporting: Sponsors maintain projects and report on progress and completion; monitoring and reporting requirements vary by project and are set out in the application.

calls.label: Twice-yearly funding cycle
calls.recurring: Application deadlines are March 1 and September 1 each year

status.quote: Application deadlines are March 1 and September 1 annually

recurring.quote: Application deadlines are March 1 and September 1 annually

applicant_types.quote: The Board may grant funds only to non-profit and governmental organizations

geography.quote: Conservation, maintenance, protection and development of wildlife resources, the environment, and Wyoming's natural resource heritage.

access.quote: Applicants for funding should use the form attached to these guidelines.

window.quote: Projects will be funded twice annually, with funds made available for approved projects in July and January.

reporting.quote: Sponsoring entities will have the responsibility to maintain projects, and to report on progress and completion.
